race.comment: A decent race at acceptances but smashed by 13 scratchings. It leaves the way open for MISHANI EXTREME (16) who was far from disgraced in Saturday metro company at Eagle Farm last start. The winner of both runs at Ipswich - must be considered especially now that the outer barrier is not an issue. CUTEPI (13) failed to fire first-up at the Sunshine Coast over 1000m. Has a decent second-up record and is far more at home over this slightly longer journey. Ready for sharp improvement in this more suitable contest. DUKE OF CAMDEN (11) is back after a 19-week spell and is a recent arrival in the Tony Gollan stable. Opened last prep with a close second over 1300m at Kembla. Looked good in his only trial since coming north. Expected to make an immediate impact. RUN LUCY RUN (8) is also fresh from a 19-week break. Usually better after a run or two but is undefeated at Ipswich so keep her in mind. APOLLO TEN (17) wasn't far away at Doomben last time. Distance specialist with definite claims.
